analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($371.54) above SMA5 ($362.22), below SMA20 ($392.08)/SMA50 ($386.56): short-term bullish, mid-term bearish position.
· Below SMA100 ($397.60), above SMA200 ($368.47): longer-term bearish trend dominance.
· 52-week position (40.6%) + current price range is a recovery from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.2 → 43.9): exiting oversold, continuing sideways in neutral range.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5.7764 → -4.4801): improving in negative territory, weak signal for bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $392.08): trading near the middle band, normal bandwidth.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($370.65): pivot-based support.
· Swing resistance ($374.23): near 5-day high, potential for short-term bullish reversal if broken.
· 5-day high $375.13, 20-day high $432.73 → Lower High pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.12x): normal confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): condition to wait and see until trend reversal is confirmed.
